batch: Exodus Block 2 - Wilderness, Sinai & the Covenant (Ex 15:22-24:18), passages cast by scene / operation-web

units.characteristics: the first testing past the sea; bitter water made sweet; the healer-statute
units.gist: NARRATIVE - three days no water, then BITTER (mar 15:23) water at Marah; the people grumble; the wood makes it sweet; God sets a STATUTE (mishpat 15:25) and tests them - 'if you diligently LISTEN (azan 15:26), do what is RIGHT (yashar), KEEP (shamar) his commandments, I will put none of the diseases on you, for I am the LORD your healer' - the song fades fast into grumbling; the test of trust at the first hardship

units.characteristics: grumbling for meat; the daily-bread test; the sabbath rest; the glory
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the whole congregation grumbles ('would we had died in Egypt by the fleshpots'); the LORD's GLORY (kavod 16:7,10) appears; he GIVES (natan 16:8,15,29) bread from heaven and MEAT (basar 16:3,8,12); each gathers per PERSON (nephesh 16:16), some MORE some less (ravah 16:17,18) but none lacks; kept over, it STINKS (baash 16:20) and Moses ANGRY (qatsaph); the sixth-day double, the seventh HOLY (qodesh 16:23) REST (nuach), 'how long will you refuse to KEEP (shamar 16:28)?'; the jar LAID UP (nuach 16:33) - the daily-bread test of trust and the sabbath

units.characteristics: the quarreling at Meribah; is the LORD among us; Amalek and the steady hands
units.gist: NARRATIVE - no water, the people QUARREL (riv 17:2,7) with Moses, 'GIVE (natan) us water'; Massah/Meribah - 'is the LORD among us or not?' (the testing); water from the rock; then Amalek attacks - Joshua CHOSEN (bachar 17:9), Moses' hand UP (rum 17:11) they PREVAIL (gavar), LOWERED (nuach) they lose; his hands held STEADY (emunah 17:12, faithfulness) till sunset - the testing-quarrel and the battle sustained by held-up hands

units.characteristics: Jethro's rejoicing; the wise counsel; able, God-fearing, trustworthy judges
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jethro comes; they ASK (shaal 18:7) each other's WELFARE (shalom); Moses tells the HARDSHIP (telaah 18:8), Jethro REJOICES (chadah 18:9) - 'now I know the LORD is greater... in the thing they dealt ARROGANTLY (zid 18:11)'; Moses JUDGES (shaphat 18:13) alone, the people INQUIRE (darash) of God; Jethro - 'not GOOD (tov 18:17), you will WITHER (navel 18:18); ADVICE (yaats 18:19): choose ABLE (chayil 18:21), God-FEARING (yare), TRUSTWORTHY (emet) men who HATE (sane) a bribe, to JUDGE (shaphat)'; Moses CHOSE (bachar 18:25) them - the wise delegation, the God-fearing judge

units.characteristics: the covenant proposal; a kingdom of priests; consecration; the trembling mountain
units.gist: GEM - God CALLS (qara 19:3) from the mountain; the COVENANT (berit 19:5) proposal - 'if you will INDEED OBEY (shama 19:5) my voice and KEEP (shamar) my COVENANT, you shall be my treasured possession... a kingdom of priests, a HOLY (qadosh 19:6) nation'; the people BELIEVE (aman 19:9); CONSECRATE (qadash 19:10,14) them; the theophany - thunder, fire, the mountain TREMBLED (charad 19:18) and the people TREMBLED (charad 19:16), the trumpet LOUDER (chazeq 19:19); WARN (ud 19:21,23) them not to break through - the covenant offered, the holy dread at the mountain

units.characteristics: the Ten Words; jealous God and steadfast love; coveting; the fear that keeps from sin
units.gist: GEM - the Ten Words; 'I the LORD your God am JEALOUS (qanna 20:5), visiting the INIQUITY (avon) of those who HATE (sane) me, but showing STEADFAST LOVE (chesed 20:6) to thousands who love and KEEP (shamar)'; REMEMBER (zakhar 20:8) the sabbath HOLY (qadash), do not LABOR (avad 20:9); honor father/mother that your days be LONG (arakh 20:12); no FALSE (sheqer 20:16) witness; do not COVET (chamad 20:17) - the DESIRE of the inner being named as law; the people fear, Moses - 'do not FEAR (yare 20:20); God has come that the FEAR (yirah) of him may be before you, that you may not SIN (chata)' - the law reaching the heart (coveting), the fear-of-God as the guard against sin

units.characteristics: the Book of the Covenant: bondservant release, injury, life for life
units.gist: LAW/NARRATIVE - the RULES (mishpat 21:1); the Hebrew SLAVE (avad 21:2,6) freed in the seventh year, or the pierced ear (permanent love-service); the daughter dealt TREACHEROUSLY (bagad 21:8) REDEEMED (padah); the murderer's CUNNING (ormah 21:14) WILLFULNESS (zid) vs accident; men who STRIVE (natsah 21:22); LIFE (nephesh 21:23) for life; the slave whose eye is DESTROYED (shachat 21:26) freed; the ox whose owner was WARNED (ud 21:29) - inner-being in the law: intent (willful vs accidental), the value of a LIFE, the servant's love-choice

units.characteristics: property law; and God's compassion for the widow, orphan, sojourner
units.gist: LAW/GEM - restitution and safekeeping (shamar 22:7,10); the trust dispute (pesha 22:9, the judges CONDEMN/rasha); then the VULNERABLE - 'you shall not AFFLICT (anah 22:22,23) any widow or orphan; if you do and they CRY to me, I will surely hear, my anger will BURN (charah 22:24)'; the pledge-cloak returned by nightfall, 'for I am COMPASSIONATE (channun 22:27)'; do not CURSE (arar 22:28) God/rulers; be men CONSECRATED (qodesh 22:31) - the law revealing God's HEART for the powerless (his compassion, his hearing of their cry - echoing Israel's own cry)

units.characteristics: justice not swayed; you know the heart of a sojourner; the sabbath rest; the covenant-angel
units.gist: LAW/GEM - no false REPORT (shema 23:1) with the WICKED (rasha); do not follow a crowd to do EVIL (raah 23:2) or pervert JUSTICE (mishpat 23:6); help your ENEMY'S (oyev 23:4) donkey, the one who HATES (sane 23:5) you; ACQUIT (tsadeq 23:7) not the wicked, the bribe SUBVERTS (salaph 23:8); 'you shall not oppress a sojourner, for you KNOW the HEART/soul (nephesh 23:9) of a sojourner, since you were sojourners in Egypt' - THE ethical memory; the sabbath REST (nuach 23:12), land REFRESHED (naphash); the covenant-angel - do not REBEL (marar 23:21), OBEY (shama) his voice, he will not pardon TRANSGRESSION (pesha 23:21); TERROR (emah 23:27) sent before them; do not SERVE (avad 23:24,33) their gods - justice from the inside, the sojourner's heart known

units.characteristics: all we will do and obey; the blood of the covenant; the elders see God; Moses into the glory
units.gist: GEM - Moses tells the RULES (mishpat 24:3); the people - 'all that the LORD says we will DO and be OBEDIENT (shama 24:7)'; the altar, the blood - half on the altar, half sprinkled on the people, 'the blood of the COVENANT (berit 24:8) which the LORD has CUT (karat) with you'; the elders go up and SEE God, under his feet a pavement of sapphire, like the CLEARNESS/PURITY (tohar 24:10) of heaven, and eat and drink; the GLORY (kavod 24:16,17) like devouring fire on the mountain; Moses CALLED (qara 24:16) into the cloud forty days - the covenant sworn and sealed in blood, the vision of God, Moses into the glory
